page.layout: One page: title page. Centred lines of text from top to bottom, with a woodcut ornament (cornucopia with a putto head) between the lines and the imprint. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.l: Cum commentario libro sive notis ejusdem,

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between "Ordinum Frisiæ Delegatos, &c." and "ARNHEMIAE," (cornucopia with a putto head, ribbons and tassels); no text. The tilde-like marks after "Edente" and "emendante" are abbreviation or ligature signs, transcribed here as a combining tilde; their exact form is uncertain. The date line is printed with a stop after each M, D and C, copied as printed.
